g.text: HIGH and LOW must never overlap. SHARE closes only after HIGH / LOW have opened.

g.desc: HIGH and LOW must never overlap. SHARE closes only after HIGH / LOW have opened.

g.text: Tiny Tapeout 1x2 analog macro | 1.8 V | LSB first | transistor dimensions shown as W / L

g.desc: Tiny Tapeout 1x2 analog macro | 1.8 V | LSB first | transistor dimensions shown as W / L

g.text: No on-chip word counter is required.

g.desc: No on-chip word counter is required.

g.text: ui_in[0] = HIGH ui_in[1] = LOW ui_in[2] = SHARE ua[0] = VREFH ua[1] = VOUT ua[2] = VREFL

g.desc: ui_in[0] = HIGH ui_in[1] = LOW ui_in[2] = SHARE ua[0] = VREFH ua[1] = VOUT ua[2] = VREFL

g.text: Bulk ties: every NMOS -> VGND; every PMOS -> VDPWR. Bulk pins are implicit in this drawing and explicit in the silicon netlist.

g.desc: Bulk ties: every NMOS -> VGND; every PMOS -> VDPWR. Bulk pins are implicit in this drawing and explicit in the silicon netlist.

g.text: Initialize: HIGH=0, LOW=1, SHARE=1 for 8 us. Then 8 bits, LSB first: charge 2 us, dead 0.2 us, share 2 us, dead 0.2 us.

g.desc: Initialize: HIGH=0, LOW=1, SHARE=1 for 8 us. Then 8 bits, LSB first: charge 2 us, dead 0.2 us, share 2 us, dead 0.2 us.

g.text: Unused digital outputs are tied to VGND; ua[3:7] are isolated. Supply bypassing is provided by the Tiny Tapeout chip / board.

g.desc: Unused digital outputs are tied to VGND; ua[3:7] are isolated. Supply bypassing is provided by the Tiny Tapeout chip / board.

g.text: C1 and C2 perform the D/A conversion.

g.desc: C1 and C2 perform the D/A conversion.
